class.name: MaszynaMoverElectricEngineConfiguration
class.brief_description: What the Mover's model of an electric engine is configured with.
class.description: What the Mover's model of an electric engine is configured with: the circuit's resistance, the tuhex relay settings and the converter overload relay's behaviour. Shared by the series and the induction engine adapters and read by MaszynaMoverCircuitUnit.

members.member: [code]Circuit:CircuitRes[/code] Motor and circuit resistance, in ohms.
[code]Circuit:TUHEX_Sum[/code] Current ED braking regulator setpoint (sum of excitation and rotor currents).
[code]Circuit:TUHEX_Diff[/code] Hysteresis of the ED braking regulator.
[code]Circuit:TUHEX_MinIw[/code] Minimum excitation current during ED braking, resulting from the traction motor's magnetization curve.
[code]Circuit:TUHEX_MaxIw[/code] Maximum excitation current during ED braking (limits max braking force).

[code]Circuit:TUHEX_Stages[/code] Number of distinct ED braking stages. When greater than 0, [member circuit_tuhex_sum_1], [member circuit_tuhex_sum_2] and [member circuit_tuhex_sum_3] should also be set.
